checks: Explicit consent shows current CRM identity and permissions; server errors stay actionable.
Mobile consent wraps without horizontal overflow; cancel returns to the validated callback.
Existing CRM sign-in returns to the pending connection and clears the local return path.
MCP URL and manual fields copy exactly; automatic setup saves without env edits, checks public discovery and exposes actionable failures.
The scope manager saves field restrictions, previews a profile and explains effective access on desktop and phone.
The mobile approval view displays the exact before and proposed amounts and queues the authorized request.
Running batches display per-item progress and allow cancelling the remaining actions on a phone.
Organization controls save fiscal calendar, draft access and report limits with an optimistic revision.
AI image generation shows provider readiness, can be toggled with the keyboard and saves separately from draft access.
Settings shows this installation’s endpoint and active sessions; disconnect refreshes the session list.
